When thousands of shoppers take the time to leave a review, it’s usually a sign a product is doing something right.

From the Australian-made quilt that’s earned a near-perfect score to the humble towels reviewers compare to those in luxury hotels, these are some of the highest-rated home products available at Myer right now.

Together, they’ve accumulated more than 11,000 reviews from Myer customers, with every product rated at least 4.7 out of 5 stars.

Whether you’re upgrading your kitchen, improving your sleep or simply investing in products that have already been thoroughly road-tested, these are the home essentials Australians can’t stop recommending.

MiniJumbuk Everyday Australian Wool Quilt

Rating: 4.9/5 stars Reviews: 1658

If customer reviews are anything to go by, this might be the ultimate bedding investment.

The MiniJumbuk Everyday Wool Quilt is the highest-rated product on this list, maintaining a remarkable 4.9 out of 5 stars across more than 1600 reviews.

Handmade in South Australia using Australian wool, it’s designed to regulate body temperature naturally, helping sleepers stay warm, comfortable and well-rested throughout the year.

Reviewers consistently praise its luxurious feel and ability to provide warmth without weight.

Shop Now

Bialetti Moka Express Coffee Pot

Rating: 4.8/5 stars Reviews: 1221

For coffee lovers, few products have achieved icon status quite like the Bialetti Moka Express.

The classic stovetop coffee maker has attracted more than 1200 glowing reviews from Myer customers, who repeatedly praise its ability to produce bold, aromatic and smooth espresso-style coffee at home.

Many describe it as an affordable alternative to expensive coffee machines and pod systems, delivering rich flavour and a satisfying crema-like finish without taking up valuable bench space.

Customers love its authentic Italian heritage and straightforward design, with many saying it’s become a non-negotiable part of their morning routine.

While some note there’s a small learning curve when it comes to perfecting the coffee-to-water ratio, most agree the results are well worth it.

Shop Now

Sunbeam Sleep Perfect Antibacterial Electric Blanket

Rating: 4.7/5 stars Reviews: 416

As the Australian winter rolls on, this Sunbeam electric blanket continues to win loyal fans.

Featuring Sunbeam’s Sleep Perfect technology, the blanket automatically adjusts to room and body temperature changes throughout the night while offering six heat settings and fast warm-up times.

Reviewers consistently praise its ability to make getting into bed on cold evenings far more enjoyable, with many saying the blanket has noticeably improved their sleep quality.

The timer function and automatic shut-off are also frequently mentioned as standout features for convenience and peace of mind.

For many reviewers, it has become a winter essential they’ll never willingly sleep without.

Shop Now

Australian House & Garden Australian Cotton Towel Range

Rating: 4.8/5 stars Reviews: 4635

With more than 4600 reviews, this Australian House & Garden range is one of the most-reviewed home products on the Myer website and customers can’t seem to get enough of it.

Made from Australian cotton and available in 10 colours, the collection includes everything from hand towels to bath sheets.

Myer reviewers regularly compare them to luxury hotel towels, praising their softness, absorbency and ability to stay fluffy wash after wash.

One recent reviewer summed it up perfectly: “It is incredibly plush and feels like a luxury hotel towel. It soaks up water immediately, dries well and is generously sized.”

Shop Now

Dentons Pillows Contoured High and Low Profile Pillows

Rating: 4.7/5 stars Reviews: 1256

A good pillow can make a remarkable difference to sleep quality and thousands of Myer customers say these deliver.

Designed with dual-height neck support and a contoured shape to encourage spinal alignment, the Australian-made Dentons pillow has become particularly popular among side and back sleepers.

Many reviewers report improvements in neck, shoulder and upper back discomfort after making the switch, while others praise its balance of comfort and support.

For anyone whose current pillow has seen better days, these are highly recommended.

Shop Now

Philips All-in-One Cooker HD2237/72

Rating: 4.8/5 stars Reviews: 888

If there’s a kitchen appliance that earns the title of weeknight hero, this might be it.

The Philips All-in-One Cooker combines pressure cooking, slow cooking, sauteing and multi-cooking functions in one appliance, helping home cooks tackle everything from tender pulled meats to soups, stews and family dinners with far less effort.

Customers frequently highlight how much time it saves in the kitchen, while the easy-to-clean non-stick interior and simple controls have helped it earn hundreds of five-star reviews.

Shop Now

Circulon Style Nonstick Induction Skillet Triple Pack

Rating: 4.8/5 stars Reviews: 857

Cookware doesn’t usually inspire hundreds of glowing reviews, but this Circulon induction skillet set has done exactly that.

The triple pack includes three everyday frying pan sizes and features the brand’s signature non-stick technology, which is designed to last significantly longer than traditional non-stick coatings.

Customers regularly praise the pans’ durability, even heat distribution and easy-clean finish, with many saying they require little to no oil when cooking.

It’s the kind of kitchen upgrade that makes everyday meals much easier.

Shop Now

Ninja SLUSHi Professional Frozen Drink Maker

Rating: 4.9/5 stars Reviews: 505

Part appliance, part party trick, the Ninja SLUSHi has quickly built a passionate fan base.

The machine creates frozen drinks without the need for ice, producing everything from soft drink slushies and frappes to frozen cocktails and milkshakes. Reviewers repeatedly mention how easy it is to use, while parents and entertainers alike love its crowd-pleasing appeal.

One recent customer admitted they were hesitant about the purchase initially but said the machine produced Coke No Sugar slushies and strawberry thickshakes that are “like something you get from Maccas”.

With alfresco entertaining always around the corner in Australia, it’s easy to see why this one has become a runaway favourite.
